# Vastola Heating & Cooling

> > Vastola Heating & Cooling provides comprehensive HVAC, electrical, and generator services throughout Buffalo and Western New York.

Family-owned HVAC contractor specializing in heating systems (furnaces, heat pumps, radiant floor heating, snowmelt), air conditioning, ductwork, electrical services, and backup generators. Serving Erie County communities including Buffalo, Clarence, Orchard Park, Tonawanda, Lewiston, and Boston, NY.

## Key Topics

- HVAC systems and installation
- Heat pumps and mini-split systems
- Furnace repair and maintenance
- Radiant floor heating
- Air conditioning services
- Ductwork and duct sealing (Aeroseal)
- Backup generator installation
- Electrical services
- Indoor air quality
- Energy efficiency
- Smart thermostats
- Snowmelt and deicing systems
- Buffalo NY climate solutions
- Western New York service areas
